summary: Aermotor-type steel lookout in Grant County, AR (also listed as Cane Creek), NHLR-registered April 2023. Build date, staffing and access not found.

facts.status_note: Register description is in the present tense from a site visit dated 1/22/22; no later check found

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR calls the tower Ico; the Central US Lookouts site lists a Grant County site under Cane Creek. Treated as one tower, as the brief does, but neither page says so outright.

notes_for_editor: Standing status rests on the NHLR visitor's present-tense description of a 1/22/22 site visit; no later check. Access is unknown and the Register says the tower may be on private property, so no access level is set. Height is not in any source read (the 400 ft figure is elevation, not stored in facts). Cane Creek identity with the Ico tower is assumed, not stated by the Central US page, which gives only the name and county. The Encyclopedia spells the maker Aeromotor and the Register's visitor writes Aermotor; the story does not equate them. Only one search and four reads were needed; Encyclopedia used for context.
